hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.astro) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; OUT=$(npx eslint --fix --quiet "$FILE" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$OUT" >&2; exit 2; }
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.astro) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; OUT=$(npx astro check 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$OUT" >&2; exit 2; }

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in */src/lib/shares.ts|*/src/lib/resolution-trail.ts|*/src/lib/units-csv.ts|*/src/pages/api/buildings/units-template.csv.ts) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; OUT=$(AI_AGENT=1 npx vitest related "$FILE" --run 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$OUT" >&2; exit 2; }
